title: Fractured Obsidian Portal
description: A surreal landscape features two jagged, glossy black crystalline formations rising from a vibrant green and red foreground. Above them floats a large, dark circular void surrounded by a swirling, smoky mass of muted greens, purples, and yellows against a dark sky.
prompt: Surreal dark landscape with two sharp jagged obsidian-like crystalline structures emerging from a textured foreground of bright green and red organic matter. A large circular black void hovers in a swirling smoky sky composed of muted greens, purples, and yellow tones. Glossy reflective surfaces on the crystals contrast with the soft atmospheric background, painterly style with visible brushwork.
